title: Introducing GPT-4.1 in the API
summary: Introducing GPT-4.1 in the API—a new family of models with across-the-board improvements, including major gains in coding, instruction following, and long-context understanding. We’re also releasing our first nano model. Available to developers worldwide starting today.
body: Introducing GPT-4.1 in the API—a new family of models with across-the-board improvements, including major gains in coding, instruction following, and long-context understanding. We’re also releasing our first nano model. Available to developers worldwide starting today.
summaryZh: OpenAI正式在API中推出GPT-4.1系列模型，该系列在编码能力、指令遵循准确度以及长上下文理解方面实现了全面升级。此次更新不仅提升了模型在复杂任务中的表现，还引入了OpenAI首个Nano级别模型，旨在为开发者提供更高效、低延迟的推理选择。GPT-4.1的发布进一步强化了OpenAI在企业级应用市场的竞争力，通过优化模型架构，在保持高性能的同时降低了开发者的使用门槛，是当前大模型领域的重要迭代更新。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI发布GPT-4.1系列模型，包含针对编码、指令遵循及长上下文能力的显著提升，并首次推出Nano模型。
